author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). Inline unions on object properties now emit synthesised sum-type enums instead of falling back to `serde_json::Value`.

Code change in proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs:
  - New helper `type_to_rust_with_unions(nsid, ty, aux_out, name_hint)`: recursive variant of `type_to_rust` that, when it encounters `LexUserType::Union` (directly or nested in `Array`), emits a synthesised `pub enum` into `aux_out` and returns the synthesised name. Defers to the existing `type_to_rust` for non-union cases.
  - `generate_object` refactored to (a) collect synthesised aux-types into a separate buffer per object, (b) compose `union_name_hint = <TypeName><PropertyPascalCase>` per property, (c) emit aux-types BEFORE the struct so the struct can reference them by name.

Naming convention:
  Direct LexUserType::Union              → <name_hint>Refs        e.g. View.record (Union) → ViewRecordRefs
  LexUserType::Array<Union>              → <name_hint>ItemRefs    e.g. Main.facets (Array<Union>) → MainFacetsItemRefs
  LexUserType::Array<Array<Union>>       → <name_hint>ItemItemRefs (in theory; not observed in practice)

The `Refs` suffix matches the lexicon term (`refs: [...]`) and is essential for collision avoidance: without it, a struct `View` whose `record` property is a union would synthesise a `ViewRecord` enum that collides with the existing top-level `pub struct ViewRecord` in the same module (app.bsky.embed.record). With `Refs`, the synth becomes `ViewRecordRefs` and coexists cleanly.

Tests added (2):
  - inline_union_property_emits_synthetic_sum_type — synthetic LexObject with a Union property; asserts the enum is emitted, has the right variant types, and the field references the synth name (NOT serde_json::Value).
  - array_of_union_emits_synthetic_sum_type_with_item_suffix — synthetic LexObject with Array<Union>; asserts the enum is named with the `ItemRefs` suffix and the field is `Vec<...>` of the synth name.

Existing tests unaffected (19 pass total). The bundled-corpus regen test (generate_types_from_lexicons) still passes — it was always the case that named union DEFS emitted as enums; the change only affects INLINE unions.

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen                                  PASS (19 tests; 2 new)
  cargo build --workspace                                           PASS
  cargo test --workspace                                            PASS (67 suites, 0 failures)
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings             PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                           PASS
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen wild_corpus_compiles -- --ignored (against bundled symlink): PASS in 17.9s

143 generated files changed under proto-blue-api/src/generated, 1503 insertions / 468 deletions — net growth from synthesised enum definitions. Confirmed sample: app.bsky.embed.record.View.record (was Option<serde_json::Value>) now references ViewRecordRefs enum with proper variants. ViewRecord struct still exists and compiles cleanly alongside.

Behavioural change: yes, public-API-breaking on proto-blue-api. Any consumer that was matching against the old `serde_json::Value` for inline-union fields will need to switch to the typed enum. Wire format unchanged (serde with #[serde(tag = "$type")] preserves the discriminator).

Remaining serde_json::Value occurrences in generated output (148 total): all are legitimate LexUserType::Unknown fields per the atproto spec ("any JSON value" — e.g. didDoc, debug, postView.record). Verified by inspecting source lexicons.

Category: A (root-cause) — replaced the audit's smoking-gun fallback (`LexUserType::Union(_) => "serde_json::Value"`) with proper synthetic-type emission across the entire object-property surface in one bump.

Closes the audit-comment plan's "3+4+5 bundle": #3 (syntax newtypes for typed string fields, landed) + #5 (edition-2024 keywords + sibling collisions, landed) + #4 (this).
